_about: Census-people store for the 2010 federal election, the venue-proxy sibling of the voter-footprint demo lanes in data/booth-seifa-voter-YYYY.json (2016+; the AEC published no 'Votes by SA1' product before 2016, so a 2010 booth cannot be weighted by where its voters live). A booth's demo block is the 2006 Census Basic Community Profile counts of the collection district (CD) its VENUE sits in — the geo key of booth-seifa-2010.json — describing the venue's neighbourhood, never the booth's voters; persons is a real CD headcount, never a weighted pseudo-population. A division's row is the exact 2006-census sum over the CDs whole-allocated to its membership of the national division set in force at the 2010 election (Victoria's pre-24/12/2010-determination set) (cd-2006-ced-2010set.json, derive-ced-era-alloc.py; whole-unit allocation by 6x6 grid majority with an LGA-sibling fallback), not an average of its booth rows. Shares mirror the GCP lanes: age renormalised over the 11 B01 bands (no age-not-stated column); language other-at-home over English-only + other; overseas-born over country-of-birth stated, and the curated birthplace-country (cob) shares riding that same basis — the 2006 B09 prints one United Kingdom row, so the GCP-era ten-country set is trimmed to eight here (country order in cobKeys); university (bachelor and above) per the aged-15+ population less level-of-education-not-stated; income lanes mirror the voter stores on the BCP's own tables: B28 households by the 14-band weekly household-income grid are re-weighted to ADULTS at the data/income-dist.json factors (each band's family share from B26's family-income Tot over its family-composition mix in the CD — national mix as fallback — the rest non-family at the national mean; household mass rides the Tot columns, never B28's fam/non columns, small-CD perturbation independently shaving the splits; partial-stated and all-not-stated households sit outside the basis). loinc is the adult share below the national 25th-percentile weekly household-income cut the store-level incomeCuts record carries (the 2006 national adults histogram's cut band split linearly, in 2006 dollars), hiinc the adult share in the $3,000-and-top band (this edition's hi edge — the page's own dollar wording reads incomeCuts.hiEdgeWeekly per year), incMed the band-interpolated median weekly household income in 2006 dollars on the HOUSEHOLD basis (ABS's own published-median basis — the adults-weighted histogram would read a few hundred dollars higher, skewed by couples). The new lane set mirrors the voter stores: B15_B's highest-year-of-schooling six levels (year-12-or-less over the stated levels), Indigenous status of B01's total over persons ex B07's status-not-stated (the lane is B54 indigenous / (B3 persons - B1039 status-not-stated)), B13's ten Religion menu shares (rel, key order in relKeys, No-religion leading) over the ex-affiliation-not-stated persons basis, B32's four Housing-tenure menu shares (ten, key order in tenKeys, owned-with-mortgage leading — being-purchased includes rent/buy) over the ex-tenure-not-stated occupied-private-dwellings basis (rented-public a state-or-territory-housing-authority landlord within that base), B24's one-parent share of families, and the under-15 share of the stated ages; blue-collar (technicians/trades + machinery operators/drivers + labourers of B44 the ANZSCO occupation major groups) over the eight stated occupation groups, inadequately-described and not-stated occupations out of the frame; B42's industry-of-employment nineteen ANZSIC-2006 divisions (ind, key order in indKeys) each shared over the divisions' stated sum, the print's inadequately-described/not-stated cells beside the lane. The national row pools the division sums. A booth whose venue CD records no residents (commercial/industrial blocks; counts.boothsGeoEmpty) carries demo:null, as does one whose geo key is absent from the BCP (counts.boothsGeoMissing); inside a present block a lane is nulled rather than clamped when the BCP's small-area perturbation would put its share outside [0,1] (counts.boothsGeo-carrying rows only). Booth records carry geo of data/booth-seifa-2010.json; its venue-proxy caveats apply here too. The demoI blocks interpolate the people figures between the 2006 and 2011 censuses to election day (day-share 0.806787 of the intercensal span — the SEIFA pcti lanes' own factors, asserted identical to data/booth-seifa-2010.json's _pcti record): each demoI lane blends the two census sides' shares, a lane missing on either side falling back to the measured block for that lane; incMed and the incomeCutsI dollar figures come from the 2011 census side alone, never a mixed-currency blend. The far side of the blend is data/booth-demo-2010-c1.json.

sourceUrls.bcp: ABS 2006 Census Basic Community Profile, collection districts (B01/B05/B07/B09/B12/B13/B15_B/B24/B26/B28/B32/B39_B/B41_B/B44_B), abs.gov.au archive census06bcp.zip

deliveryBasis: venue-proxy per booth (collection district of the premises); exact era-division census sum per division

booths.booth: Geraldton St John of God Hospital

demoInterp.nullRule: a booth missing its demo block on either census side, or a lane missing on either side, shows the measured figure instead

incomeCutsI.medianBasis: households (shares are per-adult); hiinc pinned to the nearest census side (hi edges differ across the blend's editions)
